claim_ceiling: Provisional target profile only. No latency, scale, revocation, privacy, Holochain runtime or superiority result is measured or established. Queue worker reference semantics and broker profiles are source-present only; no NATS, RabbitMQ or Kafka runtime adapter or measurement is qualified. Worker-claim proof issuer authenticity and durable current-claim state are external trust boundaries; the Rust module performs structural matching only.

comparators.name: SpiceDB
comparators.scope: Relationship authorization and per-request at_least_as_fresh / fully_consistent behaviour
comparators.consistency_profile: Use ZedToken at_least_as_fresh for matched read-after-write; separately report fully_consistent cache-bypass results

comparators.name: OpenFGA
comparators.consistency_profile: Compare matched HIGHER_CONSISTENCY and MINIMIZE_LATENCY query modes

comparators.name: Cedar
comparators.consistency_profile: Same policy/request semantics and context; do not compare unmatched policy expressiveness

comparators.name: OPA
comparators.consistency_profile: Same input corpus, policy distribution and cache conditions

comparators.name: AD DS / Entra ID / FreeIPA
comparators.scope: End-to-end enterprise lifecycle and incumbent integration
comparators.consistency_profile: Compare only equivalent service surfaces; report identity, session, group, recovery and administration paths separately

comparators.name: SPIRE / SPIFFE
comparators.scope: Workload identity issuance, rotation and trust-domain federation
comparators.consistency_profile: Compare shared workload identity responsibilities only

comparators.name: Holochain
comparators.consistency_profile: Exact conductor/HDK/HDI/Lair/Kitsune2 tuple and real conductors; report simulated peers separately

comparators.name: Cedar 4.6
comparators.scope: Policy decision semantics and policy evaluation errors
comparators.consistency_profile: Freeze policy set, schema and entity inputs; separately test policy-level skip-on-error vs required Mycelix authority-dependency closure; never let a mandatory missing identity/authority dependency become a skippable policy error

comparators.name: SCITT RFC 9943
comparators.scope: Signed decision-statement transparency and inclusion receipts
comparators.consistency_profile: Measure statement registration/inclusion/lookup and privacy; explicitly classify SCITT receipt as transparency evidence only, not truth, identity, permission or proof of downstream effect

comparators.name: VerfGraph (arXiv:2611.04240)
comparators.scope: Zero-knowledge verifiable graph query evaluation over committed private graph snapshots
comparators.consistency_profile: Adapt expansion/set expansion/count/shortest-path proof operators only where their query semantics match the dependency-closure query; bind exact graph root/schema/query; paper-reported results are preprint baselines, not Mycelix results

comparators.name: ZKGraph
comparators.scope: Expansion-centric zero-knowledge graph query proof baseline
comparators.consistency_profile: Run the same query plans and committed graph roots as VerfGraph; report proof generation, proof size, verifier latency, prover memory and privacy separately

comparators.name: LDBC SNB
comparators.scope: Public graph-data workload for query scale and operator comparability
comparators.consistency_profile: Use official Interactive and Business Intelligence workload definitions as graph operator baselines; add a separate authority graph corpus with deny/revocation semantics

comparators.name: OpenID CAEP 1.0 (final)
comparators.scope: Continuous access evaluation event types for session, token, credential, assurance, device and risk changes
comparators.consistency_profile: Compare accepted-event-to-receiver-attenuation and replay/order handling; CAEP receipt does not assert every resource mutation path is durably fenced

comparators.name: OpenID CAEP 1.1 (17 Nov 2026 draft)
comparators.scope: Latest CAEP profile draft for interoperable continuous access evaluation events
comparators.consistency_profile: Freeze draft revision and SSF profile; treat as interoperability target, not a final published standard

comparators.name: OAuth RFC 7009 token revocation
comparators.scope: Authorization-server token revocation and related grant invalidation
comparators.consistency_profile: Measure resource-server propagation, introspection/cache behavior and residual unexpired-token acceptance separately from effect-owner fence completion

comparators.name: NATS JetStream
comparators.scope: Durable streams, consumer redelivery, explicit acknowledgements and publisher deduplication
comparators.consistency_profile: Freeze file/memory storage, replicas, retention, consumer AckPolicy/AckWait/MaxDeliver, deduplication window and client version; report broker delivery separate from effect commits

comparators.name: RabbitMQ 4.4 quorum queues
comparators.scope: Raft-replicated queue durability, publisher confirms, manual acknowledgements, redelivery and dead-letter transfer
comparators.consistency_profile: Freeze quorum size, publisher confirms, consumer acknowledgement mode, prefetch, delivery limit, dead-letter strategy and overflow; include duplicate dead-letter transfer

comparators.name: Apache Kafka 4.4
comparators.scope: Transactional producer and consumer-offset semantics for topic-to-topic processing
comparators.consistency_profile: Freeze replication/ISR, producer idempotence and transactional.id, read_committed isolation and consumer offsets; external effect destinations need their own atomic coordination

graph_proof_workload_profiles.benchmark: LDBC Social Network Benchmark Interactive workload
graph_proof_workload_profiles.purpose: Reproduce the published VerfGraph/ZKGraph graph-query comparison where operator semantics match; this is not an authorization-policy benchmark
Measure exact dependency closure and authorization-specific deny/revocation semantics over a versioned sovereign graph
Measure proof composition over independently signed realm and issuer roots without imposing a global sequence

effect_fence_profiles.purpose: One database/resource owner compares its durable generation and commits the mutation in one transaction
Multiple independently scoped owners install their own target generations; no quorum substitution for strict completion
Negative control for external APIs that cannot atomically inspect a fence; classify as best-effort only

postgres_effect_owner_profiles.purpose: Measure parallel different-object writes through compatible shared fence locks on supported PostgreSQL releases
Measure exclusive revocation wait, drain time and stale-token rejection under sustained effect traffic
Inject disconnects before, during and after commit and resolve outcome through exact idempotency records
Test promotion, WAL durability, epoch reconciliation and monotonic fence restoration across eligible primaries
Measure claim-row reassignment serialization with active worker effects and prove old claims cannot mutate after new claim commit

effect_surface_inventory_profiles.purpose: Validate canonical route inventory and closure binding for small organizations
Measure route discovery and closure across gateway, sessions, workers, brokers and data stores
Measure topology churn, old-proof invalidation and route-registration lag
Measure CAEP fanout, replay handling and receiver attenuation separately from durable fence completion

queue_worker_profiles.purpose: Establish baseline envelope checks and one-worker recovery semantics
Measure broker and worker behavior at moderate enterprise workload
Stress redelivery, rebalances, owner lock contention and recovery capacity
Revoke while commands are queued, delivered, in flight, delayed and recovering; require zero post-ack stale-generation effect
